'''Laranth Tarak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] green-skinned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and a [[Gray Paladin]], a marginalized group of Jedi that fought with more weapons than just a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. A survivor of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Paladin Tarak helped the secret organization [[Whiplash]] get surviving Jedi and their associates off [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the early days of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

She did not use a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], preferring twin [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 blasters]]. She was a childhood friend of [[Jax Pavan]], and would eventually assist him in his search for [[10-4TO|Bug-Eyes]], and later join [[Whiplash]] with him.

==Biography==
[[File:JaxPavan_SOS.jpg|left|thumb|Laranth Tarak and Jax Pavan]]
Born to [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] parents on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], Laranth Tarak was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] at an early age and delivered to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|formal instruction]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Jedi academy|Temple academy]]. Meeting fellow [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|initiate]] [[Jax Pavan]] during her early training, Tarak was selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and saw very little of Pavan during her apprenticeship, and less and less of her old friend when she was made a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Studying independently as a Knight, Tarak became fascinated with the teachings espoused by the [[Gray Paladin]]s, a group of Jedi who eschewed the use of the Force and opted to use [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons.<ref name="CNI" />

Seeking to aid the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a Paladin, Tarak carried two [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistols]], and her belief in the Grays Paladins' philosophy earned her the disdain of many of her colleagues in the mainstream Order, many of whom considered her blasphemous, sacrilegious, and heterodoxical. Tarak's involvement in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the massive conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], is unknown, though she was stationed on Coruscant when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] betrayed the Order by issuing [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] on every front opened fire on their Jedi leaders while members of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] stormed the Jedi Temple as part of [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]]. Aiding in evacuating Initiates, Padawans, and [[Temple employee]]s, Tarak ran into Pavan as he fled the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple Precinct]] and into the lower levels of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]].<ref name="CNI" />

===Whiplash===
Several months later, Tarak encountered Pavan again on [[Amtor Avenue]] in the [[Yaam Sector|Blackpit Slums]], her face scarred and her left lekku shortened by blaster fire. When Pavan detailed the dying request of a fellow Jedi, Tarak agreed to join him in the hunt for a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] named [[10-4TO]]. Tarak led Pavan to the manse of [[Rokko]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] clan, who assisted them and their other comrades, [[Nick Rostu]], [[Den Dhur]] and the seemingly fully [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] droid [[I-5YQ]]. Following a trail given by the Hutt, the Jedi and their companions delved deep into [[The Works/Legends|the Works]] only to be [[Battle in the Factory District|cornered]] by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. Xizor, who was already in the possession of the droid the Jedi sought, killed Rostu while the others in the group fled. As they escaped the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] prince, the group was cornered by feral droids which had overloaded a nearby reactor. Escaping aboard the ''[[Far Ranger]]'', the team met with a representative of [[Whiplash]], an underground pro-Jedi movement, and agreed to aid them in their fight for justice.<ref name="CNI" />

Over time, Tarak grew to find her work with Whiplash tedious and longed for a change of pace. While the group began residing in a small apartment, Tarak set off on her own, in part due to her feeling that a distinctively bad future awaited the group. As Tarak investigated these feelings, she was [[Duel in the Carnival|attacked]] by the [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] and barely survived. After Sing was taken off her trail, Tarak returned to the apartment to find that the group had been paid a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for their solving the murder of [[Ves Volette]]. It was in the next few weeks, while the group attempted to get [[Dejah Duare]] off Coruscant, that Tarak felt another tremor in the Force moments before Sing attacked them once more. Sing [[Cho mok/Legends|severed]] Tarak's right arm before Pavan defeated the dark Jedi. He then rushed Tarak to a nearby [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]]. After she recovered, Tarak revealed to Pavan her intentions of parting ways with the group, citing her individualist nature and a need for solidarity.<ref name="CNI" />

Some time later, the pair crossed paths again when they [[Duel near Ploughtekal Market|rescued]] an untrained Force-sensitive, [[Kajin Savaros]], roaming the streets of [[Ploughtekal Market]]. Aiding Pavan in the boy's education in the ways of the Force, Tarak was forced to [[Duel at Rainbow Parkway and Gallery Row|protect]] him when he was attacked by [[Probus Tesla]] and several other member of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]. As she defended the young man from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] Force-users, Tarak was struck by [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] created by Inquisitor [[Mas Sirrah]]. Nearly succumbing to his power, Tarak was rescued when Savaros used his raw power to utterly destroy Sirrah's body with an unbridled use of the Force. Because of this incredible power, Tarak agreed with the others that Savaros should be moved off-world. During a transfer to a safe house, Tarak was downed by [[spice gas]] and her unconscious form imprisoned within the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau's]] [[ISB Central Office/Legends|headquarters]]. Aided in escaping by her friends, Tarak was brought by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to the roof of the building for a prisoner exchange with Pavan. The group, betrayed by their former comrade Duare, was forced to [[Battle in the Imperial Security Bureau|fight their way out]] of the building, fleeing back into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] after Vader was subdued by his overuse of the drug [[Bota/Legends|bota]].<ref name="CNIII">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>

===The last Jedi===
Some time after this, [[Thi Xon Yimmon]], the leader of Whiplash, came to believe that he was in imminent danger of being apprehended. To prevent this, the Whiplash council selected Pavan, Tarak, Dhur and I-5 to escort him to Dantooine. En route, they were forced out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] by a gravity well generator and faced capture from a wing of ships commanded by Darth Vader. Pavan gave the order to abandon ship, but Tarak waited until Vader's flagship had lowered its shields to board them, and fired a laser cannon at the ship at point-blank range. Backblast and shrapnel from the ensuing explosion fatally injured her, and moments later she died in Pavan's arms. Her last words to her lover were the final line of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]], "There is no death, there is the Force."<ref name="LJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
